internal_lifecycle_contract.admission: CodebaseMemoryProcess owns one active structural handle. start_exchange requires a running healthy stdio child, exact typed execution key, future monotonic deadline, canonical request bytes and no active handle; it registers state before writing stdin. Busy, expired, stopped, failed or quarantined fails content-free before child I/O.
internal_lifecycle_contract.client_boundary: CodebaseMemoryClient adds one internal start_structural_query path for the exact query_structural JSON-RPC method. It owns the request ID and canonical envelope, never exposes arbitrary methods, and parses or validates response identity only after the process handle reports uninterrupted terminal join.
internal_lifecycle_contract.deadline: Structural cleanup uses a dedicated monotonic budget of at most 1000 ms, configurable downward for tests only. Terminate receives at most the first 250 ms; kill plus process.wait and task join consume the shared remainder. Callers cannot extend, clear or replace either deadline.
internal_lifecycle_contract.interrupt_ack: The first interrupt atomically records one fixed reason and schedules supervision outside the handle lock. Its acknowledgement becomes readable only after terminate was attempted or the child was already terminal. Duplicate interrupt returns the same immutable acknowledgement and never signals twice.
internal_lifecycle_contract.late_suppression: The exchange task writes only private handle state. Once interrupt, timeout, deadline expiry or close is observed, any bytes, EOF or exception arriving afterward are normalized and discarded before client JSON parsing, structural mapping, stats, counters, fallback evidence or result construction.
internal_lifecycle_contract.ownership: Process owns child signals, waits, streams, task and active-handle registry; client owns JSON-RPC identity and envelope validation; structural provider owns typed request/catalog validation and result mapping. No layer may mint UIR context, register into USI or expose a direct CBM tool.
internal_lifecycle_contract.process_shutdown: Supervisor calls terminate once, waits its bounded grace, calls kill once if still running, then awaits process.wait inside the remaining shared cleanup budget and closes stdin. No kill-without-wait success state exists. A wait breach quarantines the process, blocks restart/consumption and is a terminal invariant failure for the claim.
internal_lifecycle_contract.provider_boundary: CancellableStructuralProvider exposes start(request, execution_ref, deadline_ns) returning a structural execution handle with interrupt, join and terminal_readback; it has no synchronous query method. The legacy StructuralQueryProvider remains fixture-only with product_registerable false and cannot satisfy future admission.
internal_lifecycle_contract.publication: join is idempotent and returns a detached content-free terminal readback only after child terminality and the exchange task are both joined. consume_result is one-shot and succeeds only for the same execution key in uninterrupted COMPLETED_JOINED state; every other state yields no payload and no mapped result.

representation.execution_key: StructuralProcessExecutionKey(frozen slots repr=False: execution_ref,request_digest,deadline_ns); exact built-in types, SHA-256 request digest, positive monotonic deadline; no UIR fields or defaults
representation.handle_state: NEW->RUNNING->COMPLETED->JOINED or RUNNING->INTERRUPT_REQUESTED->TERMINATING->KILLING?->TERMINAL->JOINED; FAILED_UNJOINED is quarantined and never publishable
representation.interrupt_ack: ProcessInterruptAck(frozen slots repr=False: execution_ref,reason_code,acknowledged,terminate_attempted); no PID, path or raw detail
representation.terminal_readback: ProcessTerminalReadback(frozen slots repr=False: execution_ref,outcome,terminate_attempted,kill_attempted,process_waited,task_joined,result_available); result_available iff uninterrupted completed joined

internal_lifecycle_contract.resource_invariants: Normal, error, timeout, cancel and close paths remove the exact active handle only after terminal join, clear task/stream references and leave zero active handles. Repeated release, interrupt and join are idempotent; foreign execution identity fails closed.

threat_model: The accepted CBM process can terminate and wait after a request timeout, but the accepted structural provider is a synchronous transport call with only post-return timeout metadata and no execution handle. Result-delivery cancellation can therefore leave the child request running, parse late bytes, or expose a query-only provider that the parent USI planner cannot interrupt or join. PRE1A closes only the internal CBM process/provider lifecycle; PRE1B must separately bind authoritative UIR context before parent USI registration.
